hero.title: Translate Peruvian Sign Language into text and voice
hero.subtitle: Breaking communication barriers between people with hearing disabilities and listeners in Peru.

about.title: Inclusion through innovation
about.subtitle: Building communication bridges
about.description: Bridge was born from the need to create a more inclusive society. Our mission is to empower the Peruvian deaf community through accessible and innovative technology.
about.missionText: Democratize communication and eliminate language barriers for the deaf community in Peru.
about.visionText: To be the leading sign language translation platform in Latin America, promoting digital inclusion.
about.valuesText: Inclusion, innovation, accessibility and social commitment guide every decision we make.

impact.title: Real impact in the community
impact.subtitle: Transforming lives through technology
impact.testimonial: Bridge has changed the way I communicate. Now I can express my ideas without barriers.
impact.testimonialsSubtitle: Real testimonials from people who have transformed their communication with Bridge

howItWorks.title: How Bridge works
howItWorks.subtitle: Discover how Bridge transforms PSL signs into fluid communication through cutting-edge technology
howItWorks.step1Description: Open the app and press "Start translation" to activate the camera
howItWorks.step2Description: The camera activates and begins detecting your movements in real-time
howItWorks.step3Description: The system recognizes and tracks your PSL signs with advanced precision
howItWorks.step4Description: Artificial intelligence analyzes and converts signs into coherent words
howItWorks.step5Description: Words appear instantly on your screen while you make the signs
howItWorks.step6Description: Text is converted to natural audio for complete communication

team.title: Meet the team
team.subtitle: Innovators committed to inclusion
team.nirvaDescription: Software Engineer specialized in Generative AI and Machine Learning with +2 years building exceptional user experiences. Expert in Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AI technologies like OpenAI and Ollama. Creator of end-to-end fullstack solutions that combine innovative UX/UI with robust backend architectures. Pioneer in ML model implementation for social impact applications.
team.michelleDescription: Fullstack Developer with +1 year experience building robust and scalable web applications. Specialist in backend architectures with Django, MySQL databases, and frontend development with Angular. Expert in RESTful API design, database query optimization, and distributed systems implementation. Focused on creating elegant technical solutions that prioritize performance and user experience.
team.collaborationText: Are you an organization, educational institution, or company interested in collaborating? Let's work together to make a difference.

vision.title: Our vision of the future
vision.subtitle: Expanding Bridge's impact
vision.expansionText: Bring Bridge to other Latin American countries, adapting technology to different sign language variations.
vision.educationText: Develop educational tools that facilitate PSL learning for hearing people.
vision.communityText: Create a support network and resources for the deaf community throughout the region.
